title: 🌧️ Witnessing the First Waters of the Flood
paragraphs:
🌧️ Witnessing the First Waters of the Flood
Genesis 7:16–17
"Lord, help me hear Your voice before the storm, and trust Your mercy while the door is still open."
When I read the Bible, it often feels like I am standing nearby, watching quietly.

I imagine myself hidden—not part of the chaos, yet surrounded by it.
Rain falls harder. Voices rise louder.
Hands pound on the ark as the water climbs higher.

I am only a witness.
And yet my heart feels the weight of the moment—the finality, the mercy already given, the silence of a door now closed.

⏸️ Pause here.
What warnings do I ignore until the storm is already upon me?
What grace have I mistaken for delay?
I stand still, letting the rain fall, asking softly what obedience looks like before the waters rise.
💭 Share what this moment stirs in you.
